name: Prone T Raise
instructions: Lie face-down on an incline bench with your chest supported and your arms hanging straight down, holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
Turn your palms to face each other.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms out to the sides until your body forms a "T".
Keep your elbows almost straight and your neck relaxed.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower under control and repeat.
